breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction: 'Impose the additional condition that the end slopes are zero because the loading is symmetric.' This directly mirrors the flawed incomplete prompt. A simply supported beam under uniform load rotates at the supports; the end slopes are not zero. The ground truth removes this incorrect constraint entirely, but the generated text preserves and reinforces the error.
